events.title: 2026 Mile High Drone Shows — 600-Drone Free Nightly Spectacle
events.time: Nightly 7:00 PM MST; show lasts 10–15 minutes
events.location: Tivoli Quad, Auraria Campus, 1000 Larimer Street, Denver, CO 80204 (official free public viewing area)
events.cost: Free; admission for five $0. Optional campus parking $10 surface/$15 garage/$30 Tivoli garage
events.age: Open to public of all ages; no residency or booking restriction stated
events.description: Visit Denver confirms 42 winter nights and 600 synchronized aircraft creating outdoor animated scenes, with free viewing at Tivoli Quad. A rare large-scale aviation/light spectacle, different from previously submitted one-night Castle Rock drone show on Nov 14. Weather-dependent; check organizer after 4 PM day-of. Applies to 2026 Colorado-local friends; before planned summer 2027 family arrival.

events.title: 2027 National Western Stock Show — One-Day Free Grounds Admission, Animal Encounters and Behind-the-Scenes Tour
events.time: 9:00 AM–8:00 PM MST (Sunday–Thursday grounds hours; confirm free-day access)
events.location: National Western Complex, 4655 Humboldt St, Denver, CO 80216
events.cost: Grounds admission $0 for five; regular grounds tickets adults $5–$37 and kids ages 3–11 $2–$9 depending on day; separate ticketed shows/animal feed extra, free event parking offered
events.age: All ages, public; regular grounds rules
events.description: Official 2027 FAQ specifically identifies Jan 12 as the one free public grounds admission day. Distinct limited subsidy versus daily paid admission. Included grounds attractions list CSU Ag Adventure hands-on agriculture, interactive horse/grooming displays, petting farm, and on-site registration for free stock-show behind-the-scenes FFA tours (9:30–4:30, schedule subject to availability); paid rodeos not included. January 2027 is prior to family arrival, useful to local contacts.

events.title: 2027 National Western Stock Show — Inaugural Skijoring Horse-and-Skier Invitational
events.location: Betty Cram Drive, between The Legacy and CSU Spur buildings, National Western grounds, Denver, CO 80216
events.cost: Included in day-specific NWSS grounds ticket: adults $31 and children $10; 2 adults + 3 children total $92 before any optional purchases; extra ticketing fees not separately specified
events.age: Public spectators all ages; no residency restrictions stated; 50 teams are invited competitors, spectators do not participate
events.description: Official host announces the FIRST-ever NWSS skijoring invitational, Jan 18 2027, with 50 horse-and-rider/skier teams negotiating jumps and gates; audience can watch trackside and meet competitors after awards. Exceptional new, non-routine Colorado winter sport, not an ordinary professional season game. Venue is on Stock Show grounds; tickets currently offered. Before arriving family stay, useful to local Colorado friends.

events.title: 2027 Rocky Mountain Aero Group Build & Fly Youth Aviation Camp — Summer Session and Future Registration
events.time: 9:00 AM–4:00 PM MDT each of 5 days; registration scheduled to open 2027-02-01
events.location: KGWS Sumers Airpark, 1172 Airport Center Road, Glenwood Springs, CO 81601
events.cost: $475 per eligible youth for five days; enrollment restricted to ages 10–16, so 5-person all-participant total not applicable; transport/lodging extra; scholarships may be available
events.age: Ages 10–16, no experience needed, limited enrollment; no resident-only rule stated
events.description: Five-day small-team hands-on program at an active airport, not a classroom-only hobby course: students build, program, test and fly large RC aircraft and use aviation simulators. Organizer confirms Jul 26–30 2027 session during family stay, $475 per youth, registration not yet open (Feb 1 2027) and limited seats; this is an early opportunity to note the date, not an assertion of current availability. Separate earlier Jun 21–25 session precedes the late-June family arrival.
